name: LokmenoWer/best-cad-mcp

items.name: Geometry and measurement
items.basis: Live AutoCAD run drew lines, arcs, circles, polylines, rectangles and two boundary hatches through a 90-step CADPlan, then scan_all_entities read back 81 entities (Length/Area taken from COM read-back) with zero-issue geometry validation. The pure-Python topology layer (closed profiles across entities, line-curve intersections, coplanarity, unitless arc angles left unresolved, budget failures fail atomically) has many ordinary/boundary/adversarial regression tests that ran green in CI on the pinned SHA.
items.scope_and_limits: Creation paths are traced unchanged except lint since the live run. Topology tests use real production code over a SQLite fixture, not AutoCAD. No saved/reopened or cross-process independent check of measurements; the committed DWG is not re-read by the repo. Freshly drawn entities are cached in SQLite from input arguments (draw_circle area uses 3.14159) until a rescan. Live AutoCAD artifacts were recorded 2026-08-08..10 (commits bdb6c25/d986289/b02d0fa). Since then creation/annotation/hatch/table/array/delete paths changed only by lint; move/copy/rotate/scale and all LISP-based edits (trim/extend/fillet/break/join/stretch), connection ProgID logic, DXF import and selection changed, so those are not covered by the live artifacts.

deduction.reason: Withhold 2: no fixed-version saved/reopened postcondition check and no current-SHA live run; structurally different real-drawing cases are absent.

items.name: Editing
items.basis: Live flange-coupling demo executed move_entity, array_rectangular, array_polar, delete_entity and edit_table_cell through CADPlans with a 91-entity rescan afterwards. Mocked unit tests now check that a failed move/copy is not reported as success and that edited geometry is marked stale.
items.scope_and_limits: Array/delete/table paths are traced unchanged; move/copy changed after the live run and are covered only by mocked tests. trim/extend/fillet/break/join/stretch have no output evidence. Source shows trim/extend report success whenever the LISP command returns to idle, without checking that geometry changed (see serious_defects). Live AutoCAD artifacts were recorded 2026-08-08..10 (commits bdb6c25/d986289/b02d0fa). Since then creation/annotation/hatch/table/array/delete paths changed only by lint; move/copy/rotate/scale and all LISP-based edits (trim/extend/fillet/break/join/stretch), connection ProgID logic, DXF import and selection changed, so those are not covered by the live artifacts.

deduction.reason: Cap at 2: LISP-driven trim/extend (and other run_lisp edits) return success after the command queue goes idle, including when a handle is missing or nothing is trimmed; no postcondition is read back. Requirement-driven change identity is not verified.

items.name: Annotation and styles
items.basis: Live runs created aligned and diametric dimensions, text, MText, mleaders and dimension text overrides/positions; the rendered PNG/PDF show them. Constraint tests show a text override that disagrees with geometry becomes a violated constraint and ambiguous dimensions stay unknown.
items.scope_and_limits: No numeric tolerance/fit computation (draw_tolerance passes raw GD&T text). No evidence of displayed result after dimension-style or text-style edits. The demo image shows dimensions drawn outside the sheet frame that the verification did not flag. Live AutoCAD artifacts were recorded 2026-08-08..10 (commits bdb6c25/d986289/b02d0fa). Since then creation/annotation/hatch/table/array/delete paths changed only by lint; move/copy/rotate/scale and all LISP-based edits (trim/extend/fillet/break/join/stretch), connection ProgID logic, DXF import and selection changed, so those are not covered by the live artifacts.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no error/boundary behavioral evidence for annotation in AutoCAD, no tolerance/fit support and no post-edit display check.

items.name: Organization and exchange
items.basis: Layers, a native TABLE (add_table/edit_table_cell/format_table) and DWG save, DXF export and A3 PDF plot were produced in the live demo; the DXF and PDF are committed. DXF import refuses Documents.Open for .dxf and requires allow_modify (mocked tests).
items.scope_and_limits: Blocks/attributes, xrefs, layouts, viewports and page setups have entry points but no output evidence. DXF import was added after the live runs and is evidenced only with a mocked controller. Exports confirm file existence only. Live AutoCAD artifacts were recorded 2026-08-08..10 (commits bdb6c25/d986289/b02d0fa). Since then creation/annotation/hatch/table/array/delete paths changed only by lint; move/copy/rotate/scale and all LISP-based edits (trim/extend/fillet/break/join/stretch), connection ProgID logic, DXF import and selection changed, so those are not covered by the live artifacts.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: block/attribute and paper-space/viewport paths lack output evidence; no reopen or exchange round-trip checks.

items.name: Domain workflows
items.basis: The declared domain is mechanical drawings plus drawing understanding. Live artifacts show a three-view bearing housing and a flange-coupling assembly with BOM table and item leaders, and a VLM review grounded to handles with the section hatch correctly left ambiguous. Rule-based semantic detection (slots, bolt circles, walls, doors, title blocks) is tested on synthetic data.
items.scope_and_limits: Understanding evidence is on drawings the tool itself created, not foreign drawings. No P&ID, architectural room/opening or takeoff workflow with output evidence. Image-to-CAD tracing is tested on synthetic rasters only (PIL tests skipped in Linux CI).

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no foreign-drawing or non-mechanical domain workflow with output evidence.

items.name: Transactions
items.basis: CADPlan validation, the allow_modify gate, failure-text/structured-failure detection and the rollback call are covered by monkeypatched tests that pass in CI. The live 90-step plan shows StartUndoMark/EndUndoMark succeeding.
items.scope_and_limits: Rollback is EndUndoMark plus one 'U' command; it reports success when the command is sent, without checking that the entities are gone. If StartUndoMark fails, execution continues with a warning. A live rollback smoke case exists in scripts/verify_cad_understanding_workflow.py, but no result is committed. Dry-run is static.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: execute_cad_plan accepts rollback_on_high_severity_validation (default true) and validate_after_each_step, then discards both with del, so the advertised validation rollback never happens. Rollback success is not verified and there is no output evidence of a real rollback.

items.name: Intent and geometry
items.basis: Dimension binding compares dimension measurements and text overrides with bound geometry; mismatches become violated constraints, ambiguous bindings stay unknown, and unchecked postconditions are returned as ok=null ('requires rescan') rather than passed. The live demo checked 134 constraints (127 satisfied, 7 unknown, 0 violated).
items.scope_and_limits: Behavioral cases use synthetic SQLite fixtures with production code. Plan handle capture falls back to taking up to three hex-looking tokens from result strings, which can mis-bind save_as variables. Post-plan validation reads the SQLite cache, which holds input-argument geometry until a rescan. No tampering or saved-artifact check.

deduction.reason: Withhold 2: no saved/reopened independent check, no tampering cases, and the heuristic handle capture risks wrong identities.

items.name: Delivery
items.basis: DWG save, DXF export and an A3 PDF plot were delivered in the live demo; the DXF and PDF are committed, and the README reports an independent one-page landscape A3 check of the PDF. Export waits for the output file to appear.
items.scope_and_limits: No delivery gate, source version or hash, readback of the saved file, DXF semantic parity or per-format check scope. save_drawing reports success when SaveAs raises no exception. A DWG export uses doc.SaveAs, which also re-points the active document. The verification report records no product SHA.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no readback, hash or parity checks on delivered files.

items.name: Foreign and abnormal inputs
items.basis: DXF passed to open_drawing is refused before AutoCAD is touched; import checks permission and file existence before creating a document, does not modify a non-empty template, and preserves the document and settings on failure (mocked). Scans report truncated=true past max_entities. Unitless legacy arc angles and unsampled splines are left unresolved instead of guessed (real code, synthetic data).
items.scope_and_limits: No corrupted-file, unknown-entity, unit-mismatch or external-edit case is evidenced against AutoCAD. The README tells agents to rescan after external changes; the server does not detect them.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: abnormal-input handling is shown only with mocks or synthetic caches; no real corrupted or foreign file cases.

items.name: Backend contract
items.basis: cad-mcp-doctor and check_runtime_environment report missing or blocked dependencies (MCP v1 rejected, optional visual extras, strict startup preflight), with tests. The Windows release run executed doctor --json from a clean wheel. The live preflight artifact passed with AutoCAD. ProgID fallback and stale-proxy refresh have tests. Tool profiles are discoverable through recommend_cad_tools and get_tool_help.
items.scope_and_limits: Postconditions are not consistent across tools (string vs dict results, trim/extend success without read-back). There is a single AutoCAD COM backend; no capability map per operation.

deduction.reason: Withhold 2: no fixed-version workflow with consistent independently checked postconditions.

items.name: Native interoperability
items.basis: Real AutoCAD (Windows 11) live runs show save, DXF/PDF export, dimensions, hatches, TABLE, mleaders and scan read-back; the DWG and DXF are committed.
items.scope_and_limits: These are historical artifacts (August 2026) whose connection, edit and import code has since changed. No AUDIT result, no reopen-and-edit of a saved DWG, no layouts or paper-space evidence. Live AutoCAD artifacts were recorded 2026-08-08..10 (commits bdb6c25/d986289/b02d0fa). Since then creation/annotation/hatch/table/array/delete paths changed only by lint; move/copy/rotate/scale and all LISP-based edits (trim/extend/fillet/break/join/stretch), connection ProgID logic, DXF import and selection changed, so those are not covered by the live artifacts.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no AUDIT/reopen evidence and no current-boundary native run.

items.name: Platforms
items.basis: Completed CI on the pinned SHA ran lint and 418 tests on ubuntu/Python 3.11 with COM stubs (run 40690962494). The Windows release run on ancestor 964a236 ran 394 tests, built and clean-installed the wheel and verified MCP stdio (run 35863718917). Live AutoCAD runs were on Windows 11. The autocad_com marker separates native from headless tests.
items.scope_and_limits: Only Python 3.11 runs in CI despite 3.12/3.13 classifiers. Windows CI is not at the pinned SHA. The live AutoCAD runs record no Python/product version tied to the current code.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: a single Python version, Windows CI not at the pinned SHA, and no current native run.

items.name: Standard data
items.basis: The assembly skill reference gives generic mechanical drafting practice and explicitly forbids claiming ISO/ASME/GB compliance. The live demo is marked DEMO - NOT FOR MANUFACTURE with formal_compliance_claimed=false.
items.scope_and_limits: There are no sourced standard tables (fits, fasteners, threads), editions, ranges or unknown-value refusals in the code. BOM standard part numbers in the demo are free text.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no standard-data implementation; only the absence of false certification is credited.

items.name: Drawing production
items.basis: Live outputs include a three-view bearing housing (front, top, section A-A, centerlines, hatches, dimensions, title block) and an A3 flange-coupling assembly (half-section, end view, exploded schematic, 8-row BOM, item leaders, title block), committed as DWG/DXF/PDF/PNG.
items.scope_and_limits: The plans are deterministic, script-built (generate_demo.py), not a general view generator. In the inspected PNG, the overall dimensions (230, diameter 120) extend past the sheet frame, and the title block crosses the frame. Text collides with lines, and a BOM cell wraps mid-word ('SPRIN G'). The run still passed with zero validation issues. No saved parity check. Live AutoCAD artifacts were recorded 2026-08-08..10 (commits bdb6c25/d986289/b02d0fa). Since then creation/annotation/hatch/table/array/delete paths changed only by lint; move/copy/rotate/scale and all LISP-based edits (trim/extend/fillet/break/join/stretch), connection ProgID logic, DXF import and selection changed, so those are not covered by the live artifacts.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: visible layout defects passed verification; no saved parity check or structurally different production cases.

items.name: Domain loop
items.basis: The demo loop ran scan, semantic detection, dimension binding and constraint checks with explicit unknowns, followed by two autonomous visual-repair plans and a rescan.
items.scope_and_limits: No BOM-to-balloon or quantity readback, no room-area or connectivity checks. The visual-repair gate did not catch the frame overflow visible in the final image.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: domain readback (BOM/balloon linkage, quantities) is absent and the error gates missed visible defects.

items.name: Behavioral regressions
items.basis: 418 tests passed in CI on the pinned SHA. They include strong adversarial suites for topology, grounding and VLM safety, MCP v2 protocol and concurrency-serialization tests, LISP-literal injection tests and plan gating tests.
items.scope_and_limits: The AutoCAD tool layer is tested through MagicMock controllers; test_all_interfaces is largely signature/consistency checks. 22 tests skipped in Linux CI (PIL and real stdio). No integration test runs against AutoCAD in CI, and no live smoke result is committed.

deduction.reason: Withhold 2: no integration or process tests against the real backend in the regression suite.

items.name: Reproducibility
items.basis: Dependencies are bounded ranges (mcp>=2,<3). The release workflow builds and clean-installs the wheel and checks version consistency with server.json. The demo records the prompt SHA-256, and generate_demo.py rebuilds its CADPlans deterministically.
items.scope_and_limits: No lock file or hashes. Live artifacts do not record the product commit or environment beyond the platform string. The agent-benchmark ledger is pending, with no results.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: unlocked dependencies and no product SHA in recorded evidence.

items.name: Continuous verification
items.basis: Per-push/PR CI completed successfully on the pinned SHA. The release workflow gates PyPI/registry publication on tests. Release run 31231381533 (v1.6.0) failed its unit tests and the publish jobs were skipped, which shows failing reports block release.
items.scope_and_limits: Per-push CI is Linux-only with COM stubbed. There is no same-environment correctness or performance comparison between versions.

deduction.reason: Withhold 2: no version-to-version comparison and no native verification in CI.

items.name: Defaults and security
items.basis: SQL queries run under a SQLite read-only authorizer. Handles and numbers are validated before AutoLISP is built (tests). Tools carry readOnly/destructive annotations. Transport is local stdio only.
items.scope_and_limits: The code default profile is 'full', and send_command (raw AutoCAD command line, including AutoLISP) is exposed in every profile, even lean, with no denylist. open/save/export/import accept arbitrary absolute paths with no workspace scoping, and save overwrites silently with FILEDIA=0. Safety relies on client approval of annotations.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no path or operation scoping by default and raw command execution is always available; only SQL read-only and LISP literal guards are credited.

items.name: Long tasks
items.basis: Tool calls are serialized on the event-loop thread (tested for concurrent calls). AutoCAD idle waits, save retries, and SQL timeouts and result caps exist. A rotating log records tool-call context. Scans are bounded with truncation reporting.
items.scope_and_limits: No cancellation, lock or crash-recovery behavior. Rollback is best-effort and unverified. run_lisp treats any return to idle as success. No long-task output evidence beyond the live demo's multi-phase run.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no cancellation or recovery behavior, and timeouts are not evidenced on failure paths.

declared_contract: A local, handle-first stdio MCP server (Python, MCP SDK 2.x) that drives a running, licensed AutoCAD on Windows through COM, exposing 116/213/324 tools in lean/core/full profiles. It claims 2D drafting, editing, annotation, tables, blocks, layouts, plotting and export, plus 3D solids. It also claims a SQLite-backed drawing-understanding layer (CAD-IR, semantic graph, constraints, dimension binding, validation) and guarded CADPlans (validate, static dry-run, transactional execution through AutoCAD undo marks with best-effort rollback). Further claims are visual grounding and VLM-finding reconciliation, image-to-CAD tracing, and mechanical drawing workflows. The only backend is AutoCAD COM. It is explicitly beta, for operator-reviewed local workflows, with no formal standards compliance claimed.
evidence_used: GitHub Actions CI run 40690962494 (pinned SHA e02b612, ubuntu, Python 3.11: ruff clean, 418 passed, 22 skipped)
GitHub Actions Release run 35863718917 (ancestor 964a236, windows-latest, Python 3.11: 394 passed, 20 skipped, wheel clean install, doctor --json, MCP stdio verify)

serious_defects.description: trim/extend (and other run_lisp-based edits) report success once AutoCAD returns to idle, without checking that the target exists or that geometry changed. A nonexistent handle yields (handent) nil and still returns 'trimmed'.

execute_cad_plan advertises rollback_on_high_severity_validation=True and validate_after_each_step but deletes both parameters unused, so high-severity post-plan validation never triggers rollback. Rollback success means only that a 'U' command was sent.
send_command (raw AutoCAD command line, including AutoLISP) is registered in every tool profile, and the code-default profile is 'full'. File open/save/export paths are not scoped to the workspace.

limitations: No repository code was executed; scores rest on source reading, completed CI runs and committed artifacts.
All live AutoCAD evidence is historical (August 2026). Edit, connection, DXF import and selection code changed afterwards, and no live run at the pinned SHA is committed.
Unit tests for the AutoCAD tool layer mock the COM controller, so they evidence wrapper behavior, not CAD output.
Visual judgement of the demo PNG is a single reviewer's inspection.
The rubric's anchors were applied literally; the 324-tool count, star counts and README claims earned no points.
